name: 70346 · Donaldsonvlle, LA
findings: ZIP 70346 (Donaldsonvlle) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70346 (Donaldsonvlle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
